organization.name: OpenProject GmbH
organization.notes: 2011 is project origin from introduction, not legal incorporation. Founder states company bootstrapped from the beginning in official PM2 article; no known equity investors identified. GmbH is commercial steward; no parent verified.

pricingTiers.name: Community
pricingTiers.notes: Core software license has no subscription charge; infrastructure and optional commercial offerings separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified in the public pricing material read; role remains unknown.

pricingTiers.name: Professional
pricingTiers.notes: Advertised EUR10.95 per user/month; selected subscription term not recoverable, so monthly-billing amount and annual total remain unknown.

pricingTiers.name: Corporate
pricingTiers.notes: On request. Corporate plan; 250 minimum users.

moats.claim: A broad hybrid project lifecycle and work-package data model can become embedded in formal project processes.

productReasons.claim: Combine dependencies and Gantt schedules with agile boards in a hybrid methodology.
Organize tasks, subtasks, phases and milestones as related work packages.
Link Nextcloud files and folders directly with project work packages.

sponsorship.notes: Official project and deployment pages checked; no separately identified corporate financial or in-kind sponsor. This is a search limitation, not proof none exists.

requirements.notes: Official support since OpenProject 16; pg_trgm, btree_gist, unaccent and ICU collation needed.

requirements.component: Docker/Compose or supported Linux packaged installation
requirements.notes: Application and worker services required. Slim image preferred for production.
Bundled in all-in-one; cache service in multi-container route.
Local volumes in default container route.
Mail delivery external to core database.

resources.notes: Single-server baseline up to 200 total users; concurrency changes sizing. Additional workers/database consume resources.

selfHosting.notes: PostgreSQL is the supported SQL backend; old MySQL migration references do not mean MySQL remains supported. All-in-one bundles database/cache for quick start; slim/Compose recommended for production.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official installation instructions checked. Manual Docker Compose is not a one-click installation; no additional maintained provider template verified.
